scenario_labels.L: 较长 CPU 算子；request 内 80/4 扇出，规则或 burst8 到达
scenario_labels.S: 短 CPU 算子，12 QPS，观察到孤立请求
scenario_labels.SD: 短 CPU 算子，96 QPS，观察到有限请求重叠
scenario_labels.D0: 短密度业务工作，直接继续，不增加异步恢复
scenario_labels.A0: 短密度业务工作，约 50% 位置经零延迟异步恢复
scenario_labels.A1: 短密度业务工作，约 50% 位置经 2 ms 异步等待恢复

scope.deployment: one pool per verified cluster, six selected clusters, nominal capacity 16 each
scope.cpu_per_request_unit: process CPU milliseconds per completed whole-run request
scope.latency_window: planned arrivals [2,18) seconds; late outcomes retained
scope.cpu_scope: whole execution including warmup/drain, excluding pool/trace-buffer construction and export; async helper included where enabled
scope.cpu_utilization: unavailable; do not label CPU/request or callback occupancy as utilization
scope.quantile_policy: nearest rank within each run; never average per-run p99 into pooled p99
scope.seed_policy: seed changes business work; three seeds are not three independent repetitions of identical workload
scope.matching_policy: paired only within same batch/scenario/seed and intended controlled axis
scope.statistical_claim: descriptive evidence only; no CIs or production tail acceptance
